maya: Quick async  spotted a couple of dead anchors and a handful of 403s in the KB after the last docs deploy. Scan id: /internal/scans/9123. Anyone able to pick up small fixes? :wave:
kb-scan-bot: kb-scan-bot: 2025-02-14T08:12:00Z - Linkcheck summary: 4 broken anchors, 6 image 403s across /kb/architecture and /kb/runtime. Details: /internal/scans/9123/report.txt
tomo: I can take /kb/architecture anchors. If someone posts the affected files Ill open a tiny PR.
maya: files: architecture/serving-runtime.md (anchor: #kv-cache-troubles), architecture/routing.md (anchor: #fallback-policies). Images: runtime/kv-cache-plot.png, runtime/latency-heatmap.svg, onboarding/welcome-snap.gif (403).
kevin: I'll own runtime images. Plan: copy to cdn-redwood with public-read, prefix filenames with scan id to avoid stale caches (e.g., 9123-kv-cache-plot.png). Add Cache-Control header and update markdown refs.
maya: Also, cr-bot: please run a quick linkinator scan on the branch when it's opened.
cr-bot: cr-bot: queued link check for PRs. Use /cr-bot run linkcheck <pr> to trigger after PR is opened.
tomo: Quick sed I ran locally to find anchor-containing files: ```sh
grep -R "#kv-cache-troubles\|#fallback-policies" -n kb/ || true
```
kevin: Small command to mirror one image: ```sh
aws s3 cp s3://internal-assets/runtime/kv-cache-plot.png s3://cdn-redwood/kb/runtime/9123-kv-cache-plot.png --acl public-read --cache-control "max-age=86400"
```
kevin: Branch docs/9123-rehost opened with 5 files changed. PR #5120. Tagging @tomo for anchors and @maya for quick sanity. cc @lucy for accessibility check on alt text.
lucy: I'll review alt text. Quick note: diagrams should have short descriptive alts; decorative gifs use empty alt. I'll leave a checklist in the PR template.
tomo: PR #5121 opened to add anchor redirects via frontmatter and tiny note in the two arch pages. Linking to #5120 for the image swaps.
maya: cr-bot run linkcheck #5120 && cr-bot run linkcheck #5121 once both are up. Target: merge both before EOD Wednesday. If staging preview still shows any 403s after merge, we'll revert and inspect origin ACLs.
cr-bot: cr-bot: running linkcheck on PR #5120... results queued.
kevin: Merged #5120 (images). tomo, please merge your anchors after cr-bot green. I'll run staging smoke then.
tomo: Merged #5121. cr-bot reported 0 broken links in the PR diff.
maya: Staging smoke: all images 200, anchors resolving. Updating KB ownership tracker: architecture -> @tomo, runtime -> @kevin. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
